current_events: At least five people are killed, including four children, and several injured people are rescued after heavy rain and flooding caused a sandbank to collapse in Deir el-Balah, Gaza

Several floors of Aramco Tower, a skyscraper owned by Saudi Aramco located in the King Abdullah Financial District of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, are damaged after a Houthi ballistic missile is intercepted over the city by Saudi air defense systems. No casualties or injuries are reported
Iranian state media reports that explosions are heard on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after reporting that the U.S. military fired projectiles

Production is temporarily suspended at the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan after a liquefied petroleum gas storage tank at the site is hit by a drone. No group claims responsibility for the attack

Mexican Navy personnel working with intelligence from the National Intelligence Center and the U.S. DEA, arrest Rafael Álvarez Ayala, the alleged leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel cell "Los Rs", in Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico. He is wounded in a shootout during the operation and is wanted on a Michoacán warrant for aggravated homicide

NVIDIA announces it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, after American intelligence reported that a close associate of Huang was a spy for China. Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with the associate in a letter to the company earlier in the day
China–United States relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad
A train derails near Giza, Egypt, killing seven people and wounding 125 more
A Mw 5.7 earthquake strikes central Japan with its epicenter in Shizuoka Prefecture, while also affecting Aichi, Gifu, Nagano and Yamanashi prefectures. At least 22 people are injured
Three people are killed and more than 300 others are rescued from severe flooding in Erbil, Kurdistan Region, Iraq
A bus traveling towards Zagreb, Croatia, overturns on the A3 motorway, killing at least two people and injuring 20 others
At least 34 people are killed when a small boat carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of Kébémer, Louga, Senegal
Former National Congress Party politician Ahmed Haroun, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court for genocide in Sudan's Darfur region during war, is detained by the Sudanese army
International Criminal Court investigation in Darfur
The Maltese Civil Court orders four investment companies, including two from Malta and two from Luxembourg, to pay the Vatican Bank €24.1 million in damages over a 2013 deal involving the Kappa Fund
Authorities of El Hierro in the Spanish Canary Islands declare a state of emergency following a surge of over 3,300 migrants and refugees arriving on the island this month

Three people are arrested as pro-Palestine protesters are confronted by pro-Israel counterprotesters in Rittenhouse Square, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States, amidst a boycott of six Jewish-owned restaurants targeted by a cycling club over their support of Israel
More than 200,000 people march in Amsterdam, Netherlands, to protest against the Israel's genocide in Gaza and the Dutch government's support of the Israeli military

In association football, Inter Miami player Lionel Messi is awarded the 2026 Golden Boot Award after scoring 26 goals in one season, becoming the first player in league history to win the award in consecutive years
2026 Major League Soccer season
In stock car racing, Hendrick Motorsports' driver Kyle Larson wins his third career NASCAR Cup Series championship, becoming the first driver to win two consecutive championships since 2010
